root_cause: A cancelled run left an orphaned blob lease on the prod.terraform.tfstate state blob in the tfstate container of stprodtfstate001, the azurerm backend from backend.tf. Run 7842 was canceled yesterday at 08:41Z and the blob has been leased with an infinite lease duration ever since, so every terraform plan since then hangs on the state lock and times out.
evidence: pipeline-log.txt: terraform plan fails with 'Error: Error acquiring the state lock' — a blob lease is held on the state blob, lease ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003, after the 300s lock-timeout
az-storage-blob-show.json: prod.terraform.tfstate has leaseState 'leased', leaseStatus 'locked', leaseDuration 'infinite'; lastModified 2026-10-29T08:41:27Z
pipeline-run-history.json: run 7842 of infra-prod was canceled at 2026-10-29T08:41:27Z — its finish time matches the blob's lastModified exactly; runs 7838 and earlier succeeded
az-storage-account-network-rules.json: networkRuleSet defaultAction 'Allow' with no restrictions, so network access is ruled out
fix: Break the stale lease on prod.terraform.tfstate with 'az storage blob lease break' (or 'terraform force-unlock' using the lock ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003 from the pipeline log) against the tfstate container of stprodtfstate001, then re-run the infra-prod pipeline; no Terraform code change is needed.
